create_TrainFramework: create a TrainFramework instance for training optical flow models with AR augmentation on KITTI data
run_TrainFramework_epoch: run one training epoch with multi-stage loss scheduling, appearance-spatial transforms, and occlusion augmentation
validate_TrainFramework_model: validate a trained optical flow model on KITTI and compute EPE and flow error metrics against ground truth
configure_ar_transforms: configure appearance-spatial transforms and occlusion augmentation for adversarial robustness training
track_training_metrics: track training loss components, timing meters, and flow metrics with distributed all-gather logging
